messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — hitting a few sandbox billing edge cases when ISV partners spin up ephemeral gateway instances from the marketplace. Can we align on signal, tagging, and docs so partners don't get weird invoices? cc @sam.engineering @jenna.product

sam.engineering: thanks — can you share a short repro? are we talking about meter attribution (marketplace account vs partner account) or double-counting when gateways proxy requests?

maria.partnerships: repro from FlowForge partner: they create a gateway via marketplace trial; traffic shows under our hosted pool + also under their dedicated partner account in some cases. Looks intermittent. Log snippet below.

jenna.product: this feels like a priority for launch — if we can't reliably show clear billing per tenant partners will delay listing. Recommend a quick triage + a doc update before we go live.

sam.engineering: quick check: most partners use the gateway with the "pass-through" token flow. If the frontend doesn't forward the origin headers we fallback to hosted billing. Can we standardize a header? propose: `X-Redwood-Env: sandbox` + `X-Redwood-Partner-ID` for marketplace-created gateways.

leo.evangelist: If we standardize a header we should add it to the marketplace SDK snippets and the onboarding checklist — also call it out in the co-marketing FAQ so partners know why numbers might shift during testing.

kai.sales: legal flagged a billing question: if partners see zero-cost in sandbox but later billed on cutover, we need explicit consent language. Product, can we get wording for the marketplace terms?

sam.engineering: minimal code example for partners (node):
```
fetch("https://gateway.example.com/route", {
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <partner-token>",
    "X-Redwood-Env": "sandbox",
    "X-Redwood-Partner-ID": "partner_1234"
  }
})
```

maria.partnerships: perfect. action items: 1) eng: implement header detection fallback and add metric to surface mismatches (sam) 2) product: draft marketplace terms blurb and onboarding copy (jenna) 3) docs/evangelism: add SDK snippet + FAQ (leo) 4) sales/legal: prepare consent language and share (kai). timeline: try to have a short patch + doc updates this week to unblock the partner pilot.

sam.engineering: will add a simple detector in the routing layer and a Prom metric `gateway.billing.mismatch_count`. I can open a PR today.

jenna.product: I'll draft the blurb and onboarding checklist. tagging @legal for review once I have wording.

leo.evangelist: I'll update the marketplace quickstart and build a short partner-facing email template explaining the header and why it's important. :thumbsup:

kai.sales: noted — I'll loop in legal and get back with any blocking concerns before EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for branch `billing/header-detect` — build 2381 -> staging.

maria.partnerships: awesome, thanks all. quick standup tomorrow 10:30 if anyone wants to walk through the flow with the FlowForge contact.
